text:
Ask an AI for an Indian stock\'s P/E or promoter pledge and you\'ll get an answer. Often a confident, outdated one.

I built a free, open-source fix: Claude now answers from live Screener and NSE data.

Here\'s what that looks like in one chat 🧵

It\'s called screener-mcp. It\'s an MCP server, so Claude gets 30 tools it calls on its own: financials, shareholding, peers, screens, NSE filings, annual reports, earnings calls and a portfolio tracker.

You ask in plain English. Claude picks the tools.

"Compare ITC and HINDUNILVR on all key ratios"

2 to 6 stocks side by side, with red flags at each point in time. 

In clients that support MCP Apps it renders as an interactive dashboard.

"What did TCS management say about margins in Q3FY25?"

It fetches the earnings call PDF, indexes it on your machine and returns the matching excerpts with document and page. 

The embeddings run locally, no API key.

"Is this fall sector-wide or just this stock?"

compare_to_sector checks the stock\'s return against its sector index and the Nifty 50, then gives a market-vs-company verdict.
When data is missing, it says so. Every tool returns a status (ok, partial or error) plus a missing_fields list, so Claude can\'t quietly fill a blank with a guess.

account unlocks fundamental screens.

Install in Claude Code:
claude mcp add screener -s user -- uvx --from \'screener-mcp[ai]\' screener-mcp
If it saves you an evening of tab-switching, a ⭐ helps others find it. (Research tool, not investment advice.)
